item.tib: tshe sgrub 'od dkar dpag med kyi cha lag 'chi bslu bar chod kun sel
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshe sgrub ye shes grwa gur gyi bla bslu bar chad kun sel 'chi zhags gcod pa'i ral gri zhes bya ba 'di yang / gshen 'chi med gtsug phud kyis tshe bdud sde lnga dbang du bsdus nas gsang ba 'dus pa la bstan/ de nas rim bzhin dran pa nam mkha' la bstan/ dran pas rgyas 'bring bsdus pa mang por phyes te/ rjes 'bring gi grol thob brgyad la gdams so/ ban btsun phrag dog dbang gis bon bsnub dus/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis bon 'di zab cing dmar bar dgongs te/ gter kha cha gnyis su phyes nas/ cha gcig stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis rgyung srub brag rgya bo la sbas/ cha gcig tshe dbang yab yum gyis ma gros g.yu yi mtsho mo ru btsan rgyal rdo rje 'bar ba dang / klu mo dkar mo la gnyer bcol te/ phyis su dus la bab tshe gter kha chig dril du nyams dang rmis ltas 'ga' bcas nas/ 7tshe dbang rjes 'breng tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ming g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag la dngos grub tu bab pa'o/ de la las ldan gyi snying bu shes rab phun tshogs nas skye ba sngon nas lha skal du phog pa yin pas/ da lta bag chags kyi 'phro sad nas rin chen dang po mar zhi gser dang / dga' dad mos pa'i 'dun pa dang bcas nas bskur (bskul) ba dang*/ ma zad 7bla chung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin dang / nye gnas dam pa las can 'ga' yis bskul ba la brten nas/ shar grol smin gling du yi ger btab pa'o//
